title: Binance Blockchain Yatra 2025: Driving Blockchain Adoption Through the Power of Community
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is proud to announce the launch of  Binance Blockchain Yatra 2025,  a series of networking events across eight Indian cities:  Visakhapatnam, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, and Delhi . Our mission is to drive the next wave of Web3 adoption for India’s fast-growing blockchain community through education, dialogue, and collaboration. The Yatra is a significant step forward in achieving that goal. This innovative platform brings together students, developers, entrepreneurs, and everyday users to explore the transformative power of blockchain. Every meetup will feature interactive sessions, expert keynotes and networking opportunities, all designed to showcase real-world blockchain use cases.  With Yatra's focus on responsible participation, transparency, and blockchain adoption, Binance is driving the next phase of India's web3 adoption. By building stronger community connections, it brings together voices from across the ecosystem to share insights, spark innovation, and support long-term growth. Binance Blockchain Yatra is more than an event. It’s a movement. Whether you’re a curious beginner or a passionate blockchain expert, this is your chance to be part of it. Learn More Details regarding event dates, venues, and registration will be announced shortly. The initiative seeks to foster an informed, inclusive, and innovation-driven blockchain community across India, with the goal of unlocking the full potential of blockchain technology. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-06-26 Note:  This announcement was updated on 2025-08-02 to replace Chandigarh to Lucknow as one of the networking event cities.
